criteria.criterion: Prove determinism from complete state/input and defined unsigned arithmetic. Identify every effect boundary and distinguish speculative requests from committed presentation. Derive rollback of the HAMT used cursor after a failed second update while preserving old reachable roots; staged unreachable arena cells and allocation counters may differ. All arena users must be quiescent during the transaction, and roots from unpublished intermediate updates must never escape. Score overflow or invalid movement must not partially publish a state/effect.
